name: Egg Benedict
original_name: エッグ・ベネディクト
source:
A young English gentleman with an aloof and high-handed manner. He appeared at Windibank's pawnbrokery accusing Gina of stealing his redemption ticket.

[spoiler]An operator at the central communication station who's been subpoenaed because he was caught on a photograph taken by the Red-Handed Recorders in the pawnbrokery. He appeared at Windibank's pawnbrokery using the pseudonym Eggert Benedict. His last name was once Milverton years ago. He's a childhood friend of the Skulkin brothers.[/spoiler]

[Edited from in-game profiles]
